review_notes: I reviewed all of ClosedPointNonAffine.lean, which has two theorems. The first, hom_ne_sheafedSpaceMap_of_isUnit, has one substantial proof. The second, not_exists_sheafedSpaceMap_of_isUnit, is a thin wrapper around it. The only candidate for shared machinery is the global-sections computation (hAffine, hClosed, hGlobal). I grepped ClosedPointHom.lean and the rest of the ringed-spaces directory. hom_globalSectionsMap is already factored out there, and hClosed just applies it. toOpen_comp_comap appears only once in the project. No other proof repeats the nontrivial reasoning here, so a shared lemma would have only one use. Remaining uncertainty: I did not search the other Formal Frontier libraries exhaustively.
